added_endpoint_degree_pair.description: Sorted heavy-atom degrees of the two pre-reroute attachment sites.

added_endpoint_element_pair.description: Sorted exact element identities of the two added-bond endpoints.

affected_atom_count.description: Number of distinct slots touched by a stored ring-system restatement.

affected_element_set.description: Sorted set of exact source elements touched by a ring-system restatement.

aromatic_transition_presence.description: Whether any changed bond enters or leaves the aromatic bond class.

attachment_bond_class.description: Stored root/no-bond or one-neighbor insertion bond class.

attachment_element.description: Exact source element at the optional one-neighbor insertion anchor.

bond_order_transition.description: Stored source-to-action bond-class transition for reorder or reroute.

bond_order_transition_multiset.description: Sorted multiset of source-to-action bond-class changes in one ring-system restatement.

changed_bond_count.description: Number of stored bond-order changes in one ring-system restatement.

changed_edge_cycle_context.description: Whether changed source edges are all bridges, all nonbridges, or mixed.

closed_shortest_cycle_size.description: Shortest preclosure path length plus the inserted edge.

closure_bond_class.description: Exact stored bond class inserted by cycle closing.

cut_component_size_pair.description: Sorted real-atom component sizes after removing the rerouted source edge.

cyclic_target_support_class.description: At acyclic sites, or at cyclic sites whether the atom-restate target belongs to the authoritative ORGANIC_RING_ELEMENTS set; this is a support-consistency diagnostic, not an exclusion rule.

data_lane.description: Immutable packed-row layer label, retained verbatim as row context.

deleted_element.description: Exact source element deleted by the stored action.

deleted_formal_charge.description: Exact source formal charge at the deleted slot.

deleted_heavy_degree.description: Real-heavy-atom degree of the deleted source slot.

deletion_mode.description: Last-real-atom, isolated, one-neighbor, or multi-neighbor deletion context.

element_transition.description: Exact source-to-action element transition at the restated slot.

endpoint_degree_pair.description: Sorted real-heavy-atom degrees of the two source endpoints.

endpoint_element_pair.description: Sorted exact source elements of the two endpoints.

formal_charge_transition.description: Exact source-to-action formal-charge transition at the restated slot.

implicit_h_delta.description: Exact action implicit-H count minus the stored source value.

implicit_h_direction.description: Sign of the exact implicit-H change at the restated slot.

incident_bond_signature.description: Sorted multiset of source bond classes incident to the deleted slot.

inserted_element.description: Exact element in the stored atom-insertion action.

inserted_formal_charge.description: Exact formal charge in the stored atom-insertion action.

insertion_mode.description: Current frozen zero-neighbor or exactly-one-neighbor birth factorization.

opened_bond_class.description: Exact stored source bond class removed by cycle opening.

opened_shortest_cycle_size.description: Shortest remaining endpoint path length plus the opened source edge.

preclosure_shortest_path_edges.description: Shortest source path length between cycle-closing endpoints.

remaining_shortest_path_edges.description: Shortest endpoint path after excluding the cycle-opening edge.

removed_edge_cycle_context.description: Exact bridge status of the source edge removed by rerouting.

removed_endpoint_element_pair.description: Sorted exact source elements of the removed reroute edge.

reused_removed_endpoint_count.description: Number of removed-edge endpoint slots reused by the added edge.

site_cycle_context.description: Whether the restated source slot touches at least one nonbridge edge.

site_heavy_degree.description: Real-heavy-atom degree of the restated source slot.

source_atom_count.description: Exact real-heavy-atom count in the stored source state.

source_cycle_rank.description: Exact graph cycle rank |E|-|V|+c over real atoms in the stored source state.

source_edge_cycle_context.description: Exact bridge status of the reordered source edge.

trace_step_role.description: Exact nonterminal progress position within the admitted whole trace.

computed: exact unique persistent-slot source-state counts by family and axis value
exact unique persistent-slot successor-state counts by family and axis value
graph context from exact persistent-slot adjacency
observed: exact stored persistent-slot source and successor states
immutable packed-row layer and progress position

limitations: Marginal coverage does not establish coverage of any cross-axis combination.
A sparse or absent label is a density observation under this policy, not a corpus failure.
An open-observed axis has no enumerated absence claim.
Candidate and alias counts are optional orthogonal diagnostics and are never crossed with semantic labels.
Raw duplicate rows are reported separately from exact unique persistent-slot source and successor states.
No scaffold count is claimed because no authoritative scaffold identity is present on the exact census rows.
A cyclic_nonring_element atom-restate label diagnoses a mismatch between cyclic-site targets and the declared ring-element set; it does not automatically exclude the row or change production support.
This artifact does not measure learnability, validation NLL, final-test performance, or prospective utility.
